items.title: Trial Balance for any period in Mews Operations
items.summary: Trial Balance is now a native report in Mews Operations covering weekly, monthly or custom periods, not only daily Excel/PDF exports. View summarised ledger data in-app and export to Excel, CSV or PDF via the Export queue.
items.pitch: Reconcile a whole month in one report — no more stitching daily files together.
items.segmentation: Segmented release (Tier 2): US, Canada, Mexico, Panama, Bonaire/St Eustatius/Saba, Costa Rica, Curaçao, Singapore, Puerto Rico.

items.title: Expanded Availability Blocks in Mews Operations
items.summary: Availability Blocks now support multiple occupancy levels and rates per space category, accurate pick-up tracking, product rules inherited from the parent rate, adding existing reservation groups, connected-space availability, and an updated Availability Block Report.
items.pitch: Less manual reconciliation on group bookings, from setup through arrival.

items.title: Mews to Flexkeeping Task Sync
items.summary: Tasks created in Mews appear in the right Flexkeeping user-group queue within 30 seconds; completing them in Flexkeeping updates Mews automatically.
items.pitch: No duplicate entry between Mews and Flexkeeping.

items.title: Central products: multiple languages and Central service linking (Multi-Property)
items.summary: Central products can support multiple languages that propagate to local-level products, and can be linked to local products via a Central service instead of a service key.
items.pitch: Multiple languages roll down to every local property automatically.

items.title: Scheduled exports for deposit and guest ledgers
items.summary: Set up recurring, automatic exports of the deposit and guest ledgers with custom frequency and automated delivery.
items.pitch: Set the schedule once; ledger data lands when finance needs it.

items.title: Ancillary revenue estimates in Mews RMS
items.summary: Configure typical guest spend beyond the room (dining, spa) per day or stay, with seasonal ranges, so RMS rate recommendations reflect total revenue potential.
items.pitch: Price for what a booking is worth, not just the room.

items.title: Italy e-invoicing (SDI) in Mews Operations
items.summary: Mews generates the FatturaPA e-invoice and submits it to SdI automatically on bill close; status returns to the Fiscal Record Report. Part of Mews Compliance Suite (flat EUR 25/property/month). SdI confirmation can take up to 24h — don't promise instant confirmation. Release note not yet seen in Slack/changelog.
items.pitch: Compliant invoicing with no manual XML or certificates.
items.segmentation: Italian properties (Tier 2). Confirm engineering readiness before telling customers.

items.title: Germany e-invoicing (XRechnung / Peppol)
items.summary: Germany e-invoicing using Peppol BIS Billing 3.0.18 / XRechnung (EN 16931), incl. Leitweg-ID for B2G. GA status unconfirmed.
items.pitch: Meet German B2B/B2G e-invoicing obligations from the PMS.

items.title: Norway B2B e-invoicing (Peppol/EHF) via Mews Compliance Suite
items.summary: Norway requires structured B2B e-invoicing from 1 Jan 2027. Mews is building a Peppol/EHF integration (Marketplace) reusing the engine live in Belgium and Denmark; GA targeted end of September 2026. Customers should prepare organisasjonsnummer data.
items.pitch: Get ahead of Norway's 1 January 2027 deadline.

items.title: Mews Guest Messaging — GA planned 1 Oct
items.summary: Internal #gtm-rnd note: available only via Early Access with Automations; planned to move to GA on 1 October alongside Automations and Nova. R&D explicitly asks to HOLD announcements (PR, LinkedIn, release notes) until 1 October. Interested customers: share enterpriseId in #rnd-foh-guestjourney.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.

items.title: Automations GA — beta extended to 1 Oct
items.summary: Internal #gtm-rnd note: Automations beta extended to 1 October while a pre-activation safety review agent is built. Hold GA messaging/positioning until then; tell customers asking about timing only that testing is being extended to land safety controls.
items.segmentation: 🔒 Internal signal only — not publicly confirmed. Do not mention to customers.
